title: LT Verdict run-period.v1
description: Run-level recognition artifact derived from load sample timestamps only. Idle gaps are threshold-independent counts of empty one-second sample buckets between the lowest and highest occupied bucket; comparison against a requested max_idle_gap_ms happens later, at window derivation. The backend additionally enforces cross-field consistency (RECOGNIZED implies last >= first; UNRECOGNIZED statuses imply zeroed period fields, null longest gap, and zero count; longest_idle_gap_millis is null exactly when idle_gap_count is 0) and canonical byte form bound to the actual hash of inputs/source.bin.
